lines.text: The spiritual should restore someone caught in a trespass gently, watching themselves so they are not tempted.
Paul says that carrying one another's burdens fulfills the law of Moses.
Anyone who thinks he is something when he is nothing deceives himself, and each should carry his own load.
Whatever a man sows he will reap, and the one sowing to please the Spirit will reap great riches.
We should not grow weary in well-doing, and should do good to everyone, especially the family of faith.
